events.action: The raid on Room 303 begins as a textbook takedown — four officers breach, the Big Cop barks Trinity into submission, and she obeys, hands rising slowly behind her head. Outside, the Lieutenant dismisses the Agents as paper-pushers and brags that his units are bringing the fugitive down, only for Smith to inform him his men are already dead. Back inside, the moment the Big Cop reaches to cuff the compliant prisoner, Trinity moves: in a few inhumanly fast motions she breaks the nose of the lead, drives him into another officer, and turns their own weapons and panic against the rest until she is the only one standing. She drops a single curse over the bodies as a flashlight rocks to stillness.

affects_outside.enables: The Agents now know the police operation has failed and the target has slipped their net, forcing them to take the pursuit into their own hands rather than rely on the dead units.
affects_outside.blocks_or_costs: The police lose an entire four-officer squad and any claim to control the case, and the Lieutenant's insistence on handling 'one little girl' has directly cost his men their lives.
affects_outside.off_screen_reactor: The Lieutenant, already reeling from Smith's news that his men are dead, will have that confirmation made real as the Agents move in to take over what is now a massacre scene he can no longer command.

events.turns_on: The Big Cop's reach to cuff Trinity — the routine gesture of closing the arrest — is the exact trigger she was waiting for, converting the moment of intended control into the moment of the squad's destruction.

carried_uncertainty.what: Whether Trinity surrenders willingly or is setting a trap — her slow compliance is ambiguous.

events.boundary_reason: The cops' breach and Trinity's surrender (sc-001) resolve into a single burst of violence when she breaks the cuffs and kills them all (sc-003); the intervening arrival of the Agents (sc-002) is the same beat's pressure closing in, and the question of whether she is taken changes decisively to her standing alone over the dead.

events.title: Neo's ordinary life reasserts itself
events.summary: An alarm drags Neo awake at 9:15 A.M. in his apartment; he curses his lateness. The story then names the Meta CorTechs skyscraper downtown, and inside it Rhineheart lectures Neo about his attitude and delivers an ultimatum—be on time or find another job—to which Neo answers with flat, deferential compliance.
events.action: The ALARM CLOCK pulls Neo from sleep and he reads the clock-face at 9:15 A.M., swearing at the hour. The scene moves to the Meta CorTechs office, where RHINEHEART types without looking at him and accuses him of a problem with authority, then forces an either-or choice about his job. NEO, who has spent the lecture watching window cleaners outside, answers 'Perfectly clear.'
